title: Russian President Vladimir Putin Issues Stark Nuclear Warning to NATO Over Ukraine Conflict
summary: In a speech in Moscow, President Vladimir Putin warned NATO and the United States about supplying long-range ballistic missile systems to Kyiv.
content: Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a new warning on October 15, 2024, declaring that direct military intervention by NATO in Ukraine would trigger unprecedented retaliation. Speaking to senior defense officials in Moscow, Putin emphasized that Russia's tactical nuclear weapons and hypersonic missile arsenals are fully operational. full_text:
Russian President Vladimir Putin Issues Stark Nuclear Warning to NATO Over Ukraine Conflict

In a speech in Moscow, President Vladimir Putin warned NATO and the United States about supplying long-range ballistic missile systems to Kyiv.

Russian President Vladimir Putin issued a new warning on October 15, 2024, declaring that direct military intervention by NATO in Ukraine would trigger unprecedented retaliation. Speaking to senior defense officials in Moscow, Putin emphasized that Russia's tactical nuclear weapons and hypersonic missile arsenals are fully operational. Meanwhile, defense ministers from the United States and the European Union reiterated their commitments to collective defense under the North Atlantic Treaty. The Kremlin stated that diplomatic channels remain constrained by Western sanctions.
